name: ccfiles
description: Shows which files Claude read, searched, edited and committed, how much of each it saw, which instruction files are in context, and estimated (chars ÷ 4) tokens per file

selectionContext.title: Selection as context
selectionContext.description: When a file is selected in the viewer, add one line naming it to each prompt you submit

glyphs.title: Icons
glyphs.description: File-type icons: auto (detect a Nerd Font), nerd, or plain Unicode

iconColor.title: Icon colour
iconColor.description: muted icons, or coloured by language

coverage.title: Coverage display
coverage.description: meter: a glyph in the gutter; fill: a tint under the read share of the row

claudeCodeLoads.title: Files Claude Code loads
claudeCodeLoads.description: Show CLAUDE.md, rules and memory that Claude Code loads by itself in the Tree

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: hex: the viewer's own colours; theme: follow your Claude Code theme's colour names

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: on: names shimmer while Claude works on them; off: a static colour
